note: 25 Nov 2026 (the owner): trimmed to what 14-year-olds produce: rehearsed chunks plus a short detail, about 120 words of discussion. Every turn shows the chunk repertoire, varied (never the same chunk twice in one discussion, 5 to 12 alternatives per family across the six), teachers coach for the judges: giving a view, agreeing and disagreeing, linkers, moving on, asking. Beatriz: one chunk and a detail. Tomás: two or three chunks joined.

Disagreeing: Hmm, I'm not sure about that.
I see what you mean, but…
I don't really agree with that.
Deciding: So, which one shall we choose?
OK, we don't agree, and that's fine.
Fine, we don't have to agree.

stages.t: Shall we start with learning online?
For me, it's useful, because you can watch it again.
Really? I'm not so sure.
In my opinion, it's easy to get distracted.
For example, I start a maths video, and then I watch football!
Ha! That's true.
What about keeping in touch?
Personally, I believe that's the most important one, as my cousins live in London.
Would you agree?
Absolutely.
I'd say finding information is important too.
That's a good point, but not everything online is true.
That's why we always have to check.
How about being creative?
I feel it's really fun, because I make videos.
Definitely!
If you ask me, it's the most fun.
On the other hand, it's not the most useful.
So, what's our decision? I'd choose learning online.
I see your point, but I'd go for keeping in touch,
because friends really matter at our age.
You've got a point. Let's choose that.
OK, so we agree on keeping in touch.
Let's start with studying with friends.
I think it's helpful, because you can ask questions.
I agree.
For me, it works really well before a test.
However, sometimes we just talk about football!
Ha! Let's talk about getting a tutor.
In my view, it's a good idea.
Hmm, I'm not sure about that.
To be honest, it's too expensive.
Not every family can pay for it.
You're right.
I believe a study timetable is better, as it's free.
Exactly!
It seems to me that a timetable helps you to plan.
For instance, I put my plan on the wall.
What about getting enough sleep?
I feel it's very important.
I couldn't agree more.
If you don't sleep, you can't remember anything.
How about you? Do you sleep well before exams?
Not really! So, which one is the most helpful? My choice is sleep.
Maybe, but I'd pick a study timetable,
because then you have time to sleep too!
Hmm, I still think sleep is more important.
OK, we don't agree, and that's fine.
Shall we start with working in a café?
I'd say it's a good idea, because there are lots of tourists.
Maybe, but in my opinion, it's hard work.
For example, my cousin works eight hours a day!
Really?
I prefer babysitting, because I love children.
I see what you mean, but personally, I believe it's a big responsibility.
On the other hand, it's easy to find.
What about selling things online?
I think it's easy.
Absolutely!
For instance, I sold my old bike in two days.
The only problem is that you soon have nothing to sell!
Ha! How about giving lessons to younger children?
If you ask me, that's the best idea, because explaining things helps you learn.
Don't you think?
Yes, I do.
Shall we decide?
My choice would be giving lessons,
since you earn money and you learn at the same time.
Good idea. Let's choose that one.
OK, let's go for giving lessons.
Let's start with healthier school meals.
In my view, it's a good idea, because we eat at school every day.
Definitely.
I'm sure it would help a lot.
But do you think students would eat them?
Hmm, maybe not.
What about banning fizzy drinks?
I don't really agree with that.
If you ban something, teenagers want it more.
For example, when our school banned phones, everyone hid them!
Ha! You've got a point.
I think more PE lessons are better, as we sit down all day.
Exactly!
Personally, I believe a sports club is even better, because you can choose your sport.
Let's move on to lessons about mental health.
For me, they're really important.
I couldn't agree more.
For instance, lots of my friends feel stressed before exams.
So, what should the school do first? I'd say more PE lessons.
That's a good point, but I'd go for mental health lessons,
because health isn't only about your body.
True. Let's choose that.
OK, so we agree: mental health lessons first.
Shall we start with recycling at home?
I think it's easy, and everyone can do it.
That's true, but it seems to me it's only a small step.
What do you think about public transport?
In my opinion, it's a good idea,
but the buses here are often late.
Exactly! That's the problem.
If you ask me, Funchal has too many cars.
However, the buses must get better first.
How about joining a beach clean-up?
I did one last year, and I loved it.
Really? That's great!
Personally, I believe it's important on an island.
For example, my class collected three bags of plastic.
I feel buying fewer clothes is important too, because fast fashion is bad for the planet.
I see your point, but it's hard for teenagers.
Everyone wants new clothes!
So, which one shall we choose? For me, it's the beach clean-up.
I'm not so sure. I'd rather choose public transport,
because it means fewer cars every day.
Hmm, I still prefer the beach clean-up.
Fine, we don't have to agree.
Let's start with eating meals together.
I believe it's nice, because you can talk about your day.
Absolutely.
For me, dinner is the only time my family is together.
The only problem is that my brother always watches videos!
Ha! Mine too.
What about going on holiday?
I'd say it's fun.
Really? I'm not so sure.
In my opinion, holidays can be stressful.
For instance, last summer we waited six hours at the airport!
Oh no! I feel visiting grandparents is important too.
I couldn't agree more, as they have amazing stories about Madeira.
How about you? Do you visit yours?
Yes, every Sunday.
Let's talk about playing games at home.
If you ask me, games are great for the whole family.
For example, we play cards at Christmas.
Which one do you think is best? I think going on holiday.
I see what you mean, but I'd go for eating meals together,
because you do it every day.
That's true. Let's choose that.
Great, so we agree on eating meals together.
